_about: Hidden start templates: when the web UI opens, the form is filled with a random template of its kind. Templates cannot be picked in the UI — they are start examples with tested parameters. Images follow the Realistic Vision 6 author recommendations (negative prompt, DPM++ Karras, larger resolutions). Videos follow the reference AnimateDiff RealisticVision configs (explicit motion cues, 16 frames) adapted to AnimateLCM.
